settings.oidc_native_help: Manage providers in Termix under Settings > Single sign-on. You can keep SSO off or add more than one provider there.
settings.oidc_single_provider: NS8 settings allow one SSO provider. Additional providers configured in Termix will be ignored.
settings.oidc_plugin_help: Enable the bundled Single sign-on plugin in Termix. Check this on existing installations before changing the login options below.
settings.oidc_no_providers: No NS8 identity providers have been published.
settings.oidc_provider_unavailable: The selected identity provider is unavailable.
settings.oidc_no_domains: This provider has no eligible user domains.
settings.oidc_domain_unavailable: The selected user domain is unavailable for this provider.
settings.oidc_keep_secret: Leave blank to keep the saved secret.
settings.oidc_discovery_help: Termix uses the issuer's discovery document if you leave the authorization or token endpoint blank.
settings.oidc_outage_warning: A provider outage can prevent sign-in with this configuration. Keep a working local administrator password for recovery.
settings.oidc_recovery_help: On the NS8 node, run this command to restore password login and show the login form again.
settings.oidc_registration_failed: NS8 could not register the Termix OIDC client.
settings.oidc_discovery_failed: Could not discover the provider's OIDC endpoints. Check its HTTPS address and certificate.
settings.oidc_identity_namespace_changed: Termix uses one identity slot for NS8-managed SSO. Use the original issuer and identifier claim, or configure the new provider directly in Termix.
settings.title: Settings
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
